Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

FigureMethods exists and has desktop coverage, but no inspected state transition retains/rebases an edit typed before asynchronously read facts arrive. The ticket is about that ordering defect, not ordinary editor rendering. Implement either a pending typed edit that rebases when facts resolve or an explicit disabled “reading facts” state, then add an arrival-order test proving no user edit is lost.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/figures/FigureMethods.scala:58
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/figures/FigureMethodsFxSuite.scala:32

Remaining / next action: Add ordered edit/facts state handling and an asynchronous regression.

Disposition: Keep open.
